tools.name: control_audio
tools.description: Controls the audio player: toggles play/pause ('toggle') or closes it ('close'). Requires a loaded audio track.

tools.name: get_audio_state
tools.description: Returns the current state of the site's audio player: loaded track, whether it's paused, current time and duration.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Describes Web Reactiva (webreactiva.com): a Spanish-language web programming and AI learning site (podcast, blog, courses and skills), the sections available to navigate, and which agent tools each section unlocks.

tools.name: navigate_section
tools.description: Navigates to an internal section or page of Web Reactiva (e.g. /podcast, /blog, /cursos, /skills). Only accepts internal routes; rejects external URLs.

tools.name: search_web_reactiva
tools.description: Searches content on Web Reactiva: podcast episodes, blog posts, courses, newsletters and guides. Returns title, URL, type and summary.
